newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize down in good trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize down in good trade.

text.p: Argentine cash maize weakened in good volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with plenty of spot supply, traders said.

April cash maize eased on the weaker CBOT in slow trade. January wheat was steady, with no rain forecast and weather nerves continuing. Cash sunflower seed, both spot and forward, weakened in thin trade. Demand is slow. Spot soybeans were steady in slow trade. May soy was unchanged in moderate turnover.
